name: codex-ad
description: Ad creative plugin: concept brainstorming from a product URL, and structured static ad prompt generation.

plugins.name: codex-ad
plugins.description: Three skills: ad-brainstorm turns one product URL into a validated 10x10 grid of ad concepts grounded in the product's real photography; ad-maker turns a concept or brief into six-slot static ad prompts with deterministic quality scorecards. ad-maker2 adds explicitly requested, format-guided static generation and optional brainstorming.
